Pragma doesn't merge pull requests. Changes land through issues, and the maintainer writes the code: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/sogma/pragma/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains why.

Please [open an issue](https://github.com/sogma/pragma/issues/new/choose) instead and describe the problem there. A proposed fix is welcome inside it, as a snippet or a diff, and is read as part of the report. This pull request will be closed with a pointer to the issue.
